title: Pure-tensor comparisons are natural under evaluation
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe max(c,v,r), J a Grothendieck topology, B,tau and D,sigma inverse sequences of commutative ring sheaves, alpha_n : B_n to D_n level maps, phi a morphism of their ring systems, M a B-system, and n a natural number [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Suppose e_U is a D_n(U)-linear isomorphism from the finite-level tensor module to the vertically evaluated system tensor module, with the evaluation_ring coefficient transport, and e_U sends every pure tensor a tensor x to the corresponding raw-system tensor. Then the family e_U commutes with all presheaf restriction maps.

source.place: Section 03EK (section-tensor-product) and Tag 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), applied to vertical restriction in blueprint classes (2)

proof.text: To compare the two coefficient-linear maps, use ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext and test on 1 tensor x. The finite-level tensor restriction sends it to 1 tensor the evaluated restriction of x; by hypothesis e sends this to the corresponding system tensor. The other composite first applies e and then the system tensor restriction, with the same value. The module evaluation uses the underlying system restriction, so both values agree.

theorem scalarExtension_evaluation_naturality {U V : Cᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) :
    (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{v, c, max c v r} (α n)
      ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M)).map f ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((ring.{c, v, max c v r} J (D n)).obj.map f).hom).map
          (e V).hom =
    (e U).hom ≫
      ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward (F := Prod.sectR n C)
        (eqToHom (evaluation_ring.{c, v, max c v r} J D σ n).symm).hom).obj
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{v, c, max c v r} φ M)).map f
